title: ELRR by TEM Versus Laparoscopic TME in iT2N0M0 SMALL LOW RECTAL CANCER
brief_summary: The present prospective randomized study investigated the results of ELRR (ENDOLUMINAL LOCO-REGIONAL RESECTION BY TRANSANAL ENDOSCOPIC MICROSURGERY) versus LTME (LAPAROSCOPIC TOTAL MESORECTAL EXCISION) in the management of 100 patients with iT2N0M0 small low rectal cancer after Neoadjuvant Treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Tumor located within 6 cm from the anal verge
* Tumor diameter not larger than 3 cm, and staged as iT2, N0, G1-2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients classified as American Society of Anaesthesiologists (ASA) 3 or 4
